register: Established data-governance and trade-policy term; the headword follows long-standing OECD usage, while the alternative is also current in institutional French.
trap: Flux and transferts are not interchangeable: a transfert de données is a particular legal or technical operation, whereas flux can describe data circulation in aggregate.
example_tl: Les flux transfrontières de données soutiennent le commerce numérique, mais exposent les entreprises à des règles divergentes en matière de confidentialité, de sécurité et d’accès par les autorités publiques.
example_en: Cross-border data flows support digital trade but expose companies to divergent rules on privacy, security, and access by public authorities.
cloze: {{c1::Les flux transfrontières de données}} soutiennent le commerce numérique, mais exposent les entreprises à des règles divergentes en matière de confidentialité, de sécurité et d’accès par les autorités publiques.
note: Old_back is an accurate current alternative. Self-review promoted the established OECD headword and distinguished broad flows from individual cross-border transfers.

register: Critical geopolitical metaphor for the legal, technical and identity controls that territorialize networks and online services.
trap: A frontière numérique is not simply a physical border shown or managed electronically; the metaphor concerns controls that divide or territorialize digital space.
example_tl: Les frontières numériques se durcissent lorsque l’État impose des passerelles nationales, localise les données et réserve certains services aux titulaires d’une identité numérique nationale.
example_en: Digital borders harden when the state imposes national gateways, localizes data, and reserves certain services for holders of a national digital identity.
cloze: {{c1::Les frontières numériques}} se durcissent lorsque l’État impose des passerelles nationales, localise les données et réserve certains services aux titulaires d’une identité numérique nationale.
note: Old_back is accurate after normalizing the article. Self-review separated the broad territorialization metaphor from b03’s narrower national-firewall mechanism and Internet-fragmentation process.

register: Decolonial, anthropological and innovation-policy term for technologies developed, adapted or governed by Indigenous communities; the headword makes that relationship explicit.
trap: In contemporary France French, indigène can carry a colonial or derogatory legacy when applied to peoples; autochtone is the neutral institutional term here.
example_tl: Les technologies des peuples autochtones associent souvent savoirs écologiques, outils numériques et gouvernance communautaire, sans réduire l’innovation à l’importation de solutions industrielles.
example_en: Indigenous technologies often combine ecological knowledge, digital tools, and community governance without reducing innovation to the importation of industrial solutions.
cloze: {{c1::Les technologies des peuples autochtones}} associent souvent savoirs écologiques, outils numériques et gouvernance communautaire, sans réduire l’innovation à l’importation de solutions industrielles.
note: Materially replaces old_back’s technologies indigènes. The English prompt remains context-sensitive; self-review fixes the peoples-specific sense rather than the unrelated meaning ‘home-grown technologies’.

register: Established security, intelligence and legal term; cyberespionnage is the official compact spelling in France, while the alternative is a transparent paraphrase.
trap: The standard French compound has no hyphen. Cyberespionnage entails clandestine infiltration and intelligence collection, not every form of online monitoring or surveillance.
example_tl: Le cyberespionnage vise moins à perturber immédiatement un ministère qu’à conserver un accès discret pour exfiltrer, pendant des mois, des documents stratégiques.
example_en: Cyber-espionage aims less to disrupt a ministry immediately than to retain covert access and exfiltrate strategic documents for months.
cloze: {{c1::Le cyberespionnage}} vise moins à perturber immédiatement un ministère qu’à conserver un accès discret pour exfiltrer, pendant des mois, des documents stratégiques.
note: Materially normalizes old_back’s hyphenated form to the spelling published in France’s official terminology. Self-review narrowed the example to covert intelligence collection rather than generic cyberattack activity.

register: Legal and data-governance term, usually used to frame a contested question rather than to assert that all data are governed by an ordinary property right.
trap: Propriété must not be conflated with possession, access, control or data-subject rights; holding a dataset does not by itself confer every right to use it.
example_tl: La propriété des données reste juridiquement contestée, car l’entreprise qui les détient ne possède pas nécessairement tous les droits permettant de les exploiter.
example_en: Data ownership remains legally contested because the company holding the data does not necessarily possess all the rights needed to exploit them.
cloze: {{c1::La propriété des données}} reste juridiquement contestée, car l’entreprise qui les détient ne possède pas nécessairement tous les droits permettant de les exploiter.
note: Old_back supplies the conventional label but omits the article and its contested legal status. Self-review rejected maîtrise des données as an alternative because control is not ownership.

register: Formal international-trade and regulatory-policy term; échanges numériques is especially common in institutional analysis of cross-border services and transactions.
trap: The legacy barrières commerciales numériques attaches numérique ambiguously to the barriers themselves; au commerce numérique clearly identifies the activity being restricted.
example_tl: Les obstacles au commerce numérique incluent la localisation obligatoire des données, des licences discriminatoires et des règles incompatibles qui renchérissent l’accès aux marchés étrangers.
example_en: Digital trade barriers include mandatory data localization, discriminatory licenses, and incompatible rules that make access to foreign markets more costly.
cloze: {{c1::Les obstacles au commerce numérique}} incluent la localisation obligatoire des données, des licences discriminatoires et des règles incompatibles qui renchérissent l’accès aux marchés étrangers.
note: Materially replaces old_back’s attachment-ambiguous calque with the conventional French trade-policy construction. Self-review retained only the genuinely substitutable échanges variant.

register: Software-engineering and security term; revue du code source is the conventional professional collocation, while the alternative is plainer and less method-specific.
trap: English review is not révision or critique here. An audit de code source is a more formal assurance exercise and is therefore not a free synonym for every code review.
example_tl: La revue du code source a révélé un contrôle d’accès défaillant que les tests fonctionnels n’avaient pas détecté avant la mise en production.
example_en: The source code review uncovered a faulty access control that the functional tests had not detected before the system went into production.
cloze: {{c1::La revue du code source}} a révélé un contrôle d’accès défaillant que les tests fonctionnels n’avaient pas détecté avant la mise en production.
note: Old_back is semantically defensible but loses the conventional review collocation. Self-review excluded audit de code source from alts because it denotes a stronger, scoped evaluation.

register: Established cybersecurity architecture; French professional and ANSSI usage normally retains the English Zero Trust label.
trap: Zero Trust does not abolish trust indiscriminately: it requires each access request to be evaluated from identity, resource and contextual attributes, including inside the network.
example_tl: L’architecture Zero Trust réévalue chaque demande d’accès selon l’identité, l’état du terminal et le contexte, même lorsque l’utilisateur se trouve sur le réseau interne.
example_en: Zero trust architecture reassesses every access request according to identity, device state, and context, even when the user is on the internal network.
cloze: {{c1::L’architecture Zero Trust}} réévalue chaque demande d’accès selon l’identité, l’état du terminal et le contexte, même lorsque l’utilisateur se trouve sur le réseau interne.
note: Materially replaces old_back’s nonstandard architecture de confiance zéro. Self-review aligned the headword and access-control explanation with current ANSSI usage.

register: Current industrial and public-policy term for preserving practical freedom of action by understanding, choosing and changing digital dependencies.
trap: Autonomie is not autarky, and it is not identical to sovereignty: the former concerns capacity for action, while the latter foregrounds authority and rule-setting power.
example_tl: L’autonomie numérique de l’Europe dépend moins d’une autarcie illusoire que de sa capacité à choisir ses fournisseurs, à auditer ses outils et à changer d’infrastructure.
example_en: Europe’s digital autonomy depends less on illusory autarky than on its ability to choose suppliers, audit its tools, and change infrastructure.
cloze: {{c1::L’autonomie numérique}} de l’Europe dépend moins d’une autarcie illusoire que de sa capacité à choisir ses fournisseurs, à auditer ses outils et à changer d’infrastructure.
note: Old_back is accurate after adding the article. Self-review fixed the strategic policy sense and distinguished practical autonomy from b01’s digital sovereignty and this batch’s self-determination card.

tl: le chiffrement de bout en bout
alts: le chiffrement de client à client
register: Established cryptography and privacy term; the alternative is an explanatory technical label also used by the CNIL.
trap: Formal France French prefers chiffrement to cryptage. Encryption in transit is not end-to-end if an intermediary can recover the plaintext or controls the decryption keys.
example_tl: Le chiffrement de bout en bout empêche le fournisseur de lire les messages en clair, à condition que les clés restent sous le contrôle exclusif des correspondants.
example_en: End-to-end encryption prevents the provider from reading messages in plaintext, provided that the keys remain under the correspondents’ exclusive control.
cloze: {{c1::Le chiffrement de bout en bout}} empêche le fournisseur de lire les messages en clair, à condition que les clés restent sous le contrôle exclusif des correspondants.
note: Materially corrects old_back’s cryptage to the institutional and technical France-French term chiffrement. Self-review added key control so the example distinguishes end-to-end protection from transport encryption.

register: Established civil-protection, security and EU legal category, conventionally discussed in the plural when referring to the class as a whole.
trap: Critique is consequence-based, not merely an emphatic synonym for important; the category concerns assets whose disruption would seriously impair essential functions.
example_tl: Les infrastructures critiques regroupent des réseaux et des actifs dont l’interruption compromettrait gravement l’énergie, les transports, la santé ou le fonctionnement des pouvoirs publics.
example_en: Critical infrastructure comprises networks and assets whose disruption would seriously impair energy, transport, health care, or the functioning of public authorities.
cloze: {{c1::Les infrastructures critiques}} regroupent des réseaux et des actifs dont l’interruption compromettrait gravement l’énergie, les transports, la santé ou le fonctionnement des pouvoirs publics.
note: The conventional French category is plural, unlike the malformed English article-plus-mass-noun prompt and old_back’s isolated singular. Self-review avoided treating infrastructures d’importance vitale as a free synonym.

register: Specialist UNESCO internet-governance concept organized around the ROAM principles: rights, openness, accessibility and multistakeholder participation.
trap: Universalité does not assert that internet coverage is already universal; it names a normative governance framework, not the telecommunications concept of universal service.
example_tl: L’universalité de l’Internet exige que les politiques nationales garantissent les droits humains, l’ouverture, l’accessibilité et une gouvernance réellement multipartite.
example_en: Internet universality requires national policies to guarantee human rights, openness, accessibility, and genuinely multistakeholder governance.
cloze: {{c1::L’universalité de l’Internet}} exige que les politiques nationales garantissent les droits humains, l’ouverture, l’accessibilité et une gouvernance réellement multipartite.
note: Old_back gives the label but not its specialist institutional content. Self-review verified the UNESCO capitalization and encoded all four ROAM dimensions in the example.

register: Established cybersecurity engineering principle requiring security to be integrated across architecture, development, testing, deployment and maintenance.
trap: Dès la conception is not par défaut: secure by design concerns the whole development lifecycle, whereas secure by default concerns the initial configuration delivered to users.
example_tl: La sécurité dès la conception impose d’analyser les risques avant le développement, puis de tester les composants et de corriger les vulnérabilités pendant tout leur cycle de vie.
example_en: Secure by design requires risks to be analyzed before development, then components to be tested and vulnerabilities corrected throughout their lifecycle.
cloze: {{c1::La sécurité dès la conception}} impose d’analyser les risques avant le développement, puis de tester les composants et de corriger les vulnérabilités pendant tout leur cycle de vie.
note: Old_back supplies the accepted core phrase but omits the article and lifecycle scope. Self-review made the contrast with secure by default explicit.

register: Risk-management and continuity term for maintaining essential activities through digital incidents and restoring them afterward; broader than preventive cybersecurity.
trap: Résilience numérique is not mere resistance to attack: it includes preparation, continuity, recovery and adaptation after a service has been disrupted.
example_tl: La résilience numérique suppose des sauvegardes isolées, des procédures de crise éprouvées et la capacité de rétablir les services essentiels après une attaque.
example_en: Digital resilience requires isolated backups, tested crisis procedures, and the ability to restore essential services after an attack.
cloze: {{c1::La résilience numérique}} suppose des sauvegardes isolées, des procédures de crise éprouvées et la capacité de rétablir les services essentiels après une attaque.
note: Old_back is accurate after adding the article. Self-review aligned the example with the ANSSI continuity-and-recovery sense rather than reducing resilience to prevention.

register: Emerging rights and data-policy concept, especially institutionalized in Swiss French, covering individual and sometimes collective knowledge, choice and capacity for action online.
trap: The concept is not state sovereignty or data protection alone; autodétermination informationnelle is a related, narrower principle focused on deciding how personal information is used.
example_tl: L’autodétermination numérique exige que les citoyens comprennent les traitements automatisés, disposent de choix réels et puissent contester l’usage de leurs données.
example_en: Digital self-determination requires citizens to understand automated processing, have genuine choices, and be able to challenge the use of their data.
cloze: {{c1::L’autodétermination numérique}} exige que les citoyens comprennent les traitements automatisés, disposent de choix réels et puissent contester l’usage de leurs données.
note: Old_back is accurate after adding the article. Confidence is moderate because the label is more institutionalized in Swiss than France-French policy; self-review states that register and distinguishes the broader concept from informational self-determination.
